I´ve been living there from 2023-2024 . Foreigners are not allowed to give money. my Filipina GF gave money. I am deeply humbled by how people cope there. 
If not my Filipina GF I dont know how i would managed.
I lived in her community with her family . 
I myself are from Indigenous Sami from Norway , and I used to simple life . 
But her home was warm and welcoming , her community was good . 
I cant recall if I ever complained , that migth been because I felt accepted.
Back in Norway I was treated bad by majority .
I prefer using Motor cycle taxis called Habal-Habal.
( I miss Cebu City - I be back when I have finished pay all debt )

Oh , yeah . You cant dismiss Karaoke , Its all over  . I dont mind sing with my Crow voice.😅😁.
